name: Darth Vader's black Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor
wookieepedia_title: Darth Vader's black Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends
description: Darth Vader's black Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor—also known as Darth Vader's Sith starfighter—was one of several black Eta-2 Actis-class interceptors owned by Darth Vader during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
